text: {"bull":["Sales grew 10.1% in Q1 FY27 to INR1,51,836 million, up from INR1,45,598 million in Q4 FY26, showing continued top‑line momentum.","Gross margin rose to 80.5% in Q1 FY27 from 80.8% in Q4 FY26, driven by a better product mix and maintaining high profitability.","EBITDA increased to INR44,177 million in Q1 FY27, a 2.7% rise from Q4 FY26, and EBITDA margin improved to 28.9% from 27.1% year‑on‑year.","Net profit after tax reached INR28,948 million in Q1 FY27, up from INR27,140 million in Q4 FY26, reflecting strong earnings growth."],"bear":["Operating profit fell to INR3,954 cr in Q1 FY27 from INR4,302 cr in Q4 FY26, indicating a decline in operating efficiency.","Operating profit margin dropped to 27% in Q1 FY27 from 29% in Q4 FY26, showing pressure on profitability.","Effective tax rate increased to 27.8% in Q1 FY27 from 22.3% in Q4 FY26, eroding net earnings.","Net profit after tax fell to INR27,140 million in Q4 FY26 from INR28,948 million in Q1 FY27, highlighting a recent earnings dip." ]}
